source.name: Alpaca historical SPY bars (IEX feed)
source.note: Free IEX data covers one U.S. exchange, not the consolidated SIP market; non-U.S. opens may have no SPY prints.

limitations: Forward descriptive evidence only; not a prediction, signal, or profitability claim.
Version 1 does not remove exchange holidays, half-days, or emergency closures.
Underlying price movement excludes options, leverage, fees, slippage, and executable fills.
